claim_text: Reach zero fatalities and eliminate workplace injuries and catastrophic events.
metric_name: Fatalities at managed operations; All-injury frequency rate
context_text: Reach zero fatalities and eliminate workplace injuries and catastrophic events.；1 fatality at managed operations. (2024: 5 fatalities).；All-injury frequency rate (AIFR) at 0.37 (target: 0.38). (2024: 0.37).
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: claim 要求实现零死亡并消除工伤，但FY2025实际仍有1起死亡事故且AIFR并非零，构成明显矛盾，属于严重漂绿嫌疑。
notes: 目标型claim被当期实际绩效直接否定。
